chapter.title: Read Me First
subtitle: Eleven short pages about the book itself.
Nothing here locks, and nothing here can be missed.

hover: Forty posts. Not one of them lit.

quests.title: How This Book Works
quests.subtitle: Tabs on the left. This one never locks.
description: Chapters are the &btabs&r down the left edge. This one is the top one.
A quest you cannot start yet stays on the board, greyed, with its title readable.
The story starts one tab down, in &6Start Here&r.

quests.title: Move, Break, Place, Craft
quests.subtitle: Two mouse buttons and a 3x3 grid.
description: &bLeft-click&r held breaks a block. &bRight-click&r places what you hold.
Your pack has a 2x2 grid; a &aCrafting Table&r makes it 3x3. Click an item in the search list to see its recipe.

quests.title: Eat, Sleep, Find Your Way Back
quests.subtitle: F3 puts your coordinates on the screen.
description: Eat when the drumsticks drop. Sleep in a bed to skip a night.
Press &bF3&r for the XYZ line and write the three numbers down.
The &aMegatorch&r you place at home keeps &cmonsters&r off it for good.

quests.title: The Next Line
quests.subtitle: One popup per quest, pointing forward.
description: When a quest ticks, one popup slides in at the top right. It starts with &bNext:&r and says where to go.
Rewards land in your bag at the same moment. There is nothing to click.

quests.title: Who Lives Here
quests.subtitle: Eight neighbours. Fifteen by the end.
description: Marnie, Bram, Oda, Halden, Tobin, Wisp, Pip and Nella live here. Seven more arrive.
Right-click any of them; what they say changes as the valley moves. The &bbar at the top&r counts them.

quests.title: Two Lanes, One Valley
quests.subtitle: Cooking counts. So does the reactor.
description: Most of the book is the cozy lane: food, animals, planting, decorating. Start in the &6Farm and Seasons&r chapter.
Only &cfive quests in winter&r need the reactor, and Oda sells every part of it over her counter.

quests.title: Oda's Counter Is the Shortcut
quests.subtitle: She sells the dull half for Scrip.
description: Cooking, fishing, planting and running parcels pay &aValley Scrip&r.
Her counter sells casings, alloys, ducts, seeds and furniture. If a step is annoying, buy it: see the &6Oda's Counter&r chapter.

quests.title: The Journal and the Compass
quests.subtitle: Josie's notes, and the road to the farm.
description: Right-click the &aValley Journal&r in your bag: five entries in Josie's hand, and a field note for every machine.
The compass beside it points at the &bKettle farm&r, not at spawn.

quests.title: Order Barely Matters
quests.subtitle: Out of sequence is still the story.
description: A quest waits for the ones drawn into it and nothing else.
Mill the flour before the kitchen or the kitchen before the mill. Anything you walk past is still standing next season.

quests.title: Nothing Here Is Timed
quests.subtitle: No clock, no fail state, no penalty.
description: No quest has a timer and none of them can be failed.
Crops keep. Neighbours wait. A quest left half done in spring is where you left it in autumn.

quests.title: One Valley, Everyone In It
quests.subtitle: The same map, the same forty lamps.
description: There is one valley and everybody plays in it. Lamps lit, houses opened, people moved in: the same for everyone logged in.
Quest progress is shared across your party.
